summary: The figure shows trends in the prevalence of stunting in children under 5 years of age from 2000 to 2022 globally and by WHO region. All regions show a general decline in stunting prevalence over this period. The South-East Asia Region had the highest prevalence in 2000 (~48%) and showed a significant decrease to about 30% by 2022, while the European Region had the lowest prevalence throughout, decreasing from about 11% to 5%. The global prevalence also declined steadily from about 33% to 22%.
